$comment: The pod labels a usage sample is attributed by. A cross-language contract with the same standing as the signing vectors next to it, and for a blunter reason: these strings are how work becomes money. `services/metering-agent` reads them off each pod; the TypeScript control plane writes them onto every workload it creates. The two were different. The agent read `sproutos.dev/organization-id` and the control plane wrote `sproutos.dev/project` — a different key, no organization at all — so `attribution_from_labels` returned `None` for every pod on every node and the agent sampled cgroups, delivered batches, and billed nobody. Nothing failed: pods Running, samples flowing, `usage_event` empty. Both sides now assert this file.

cases.note: a project-bound workload: a tenant's deployed site, the main billable thing
a standalone backend service: TASK 37 says an organization may own one with no project
the key the control plane actually wrote for a year. Attributable to nobody, and the reason this file exists
an organization id that is not a UUID is not an organization
a platform pod, which is ours and must never be billed to a tenant
